name: chat.js
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The task was to improve the `ChatService` class in `src/service/chat.js`.
2. The `createChatFromFiles` method was missing from the working version of the file and needed to be restored.
3. The method was re-added with a more generic and flexible signature, supporting options like `name`, `mode`, `message`, `profiles`, `metadata`, and `activate`.
4. It reuses the existing `getUserMessage` method internally to keep the message shape consistent across the service.
5. An optional `activate` flag was introduced to allow the newly created chat to be set as active immediately after creation.

messages.content: Make createChatWithFiles more generic and reusable
